resources.string: Keep home screens the same on every TV, and edit them from your phone or computer, with a BanditBox server on your network.\n\nIf the server already has home screens, this TV switches to them; a backup of this TV\'s is saved first. If the server is new, this TV\'s home screens are copied to it.
On your phone or computer, open %1$s, go to Devices and approve this code.
The server turned this TV down.
The code ran out before it was approved.
Can\'t reach %1$s right now. Changes on this TV are kept and sent when it\'s back.
Not synced: %1$s no longer knows this TV. Its home screens stay as they are. Pair again to sync.
Stop syncing with %1$s? Home screens on this TV stay as they are. Remove the TV under Devices on the server too.
%1$d changes from this TV weren\'t kept, because the same things were changed in the web app or on another TV.
